England controlled the midfield as Argentina resorted to “dirty tactics”. But once Anthony Gordon scored, Tuchel made the “same old mistake” of retreating into the box and playing defensively, says talkSPORT’s Max Scott.

Max Scott was speaking to Kate McCann and Stig Abell on Times Radio Breakfast. Listen live from 6am to 10am, Monday to Thursday.
